comments.author: trilevich
comments.body_html:
Subject: Cultist Circle Improvements 1.0.2 not working – custom timer doesn’t trigger

Dear developer,

Thank you for your work on Cultist Circle Improvements. I really appreciate it.

I have a technical issue. I installed version 1.0.2 (I’m certain I downloaded the latest version), but the mod does not work as intended.

The problem is not about missing UI entries. To be specific: when I sacrifice the required item (e.g., left half of a Bitcoin) into the Cultist Circle, the expected non-standard timer (like 1 hour 8 minutes or 13 minutes) does not start. Instead, the game behaves as if I sacrificed a normal, ordinary item – the circle just consumes it without any special craft happening.

I have WTT’s Content Backport installed and it works fine.

Also, when I run Checkmod, it shows that I have version 1.0.1 installed, even though I downloaded 1.0.2. I’ve reinstalled several times, but the issue remains.

Could you please advise what might be causing this? Is it a version mismatch, a conflict with another mod, or something else? Any help would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you again for your hard work.

comments.author: acidphantasm
comments.body_html:
SPT issue.

Install Temporary Fixes to resolve it.

comments.author: trilevich
comments.body_html: Thank you very much! Installing Temporary Fixes solved the issue. The non-standard timers now work as expected. I really appreciate your help and your great work on the mod.
